claims.note: Annular kernel eta_i=3/(4*pi*((a+ell)^3-a^3)) integrates to 1 over the mouth annulus by native radial integration; [eta]=L^-3.
f0(0)=1/ell EVALUATED (not assigned) from f0=1/(ell*cosh(w/ell)^2); the tooth also protects the sech^2 shape via curvature at w=0. Consumes stage030 f0.
Odd kernel o_ell(w)=w*exp(-w^2/(2 ell^2))/(sqrt(2 pi) ell^3) satisfies o_ell(-w)=-o_ell(w); with even r_bg and r_Sigma-(w)=r_Sigma+(-w) gives I_minus=-I_plus, hence Q_+=+1,Q_-=-1. [o_ell]=L^-2.

Generic reflection-dominance certification: N_chi=I_plus=int_{w>0} o_ell(w)[D(w)-D(-w)]dw>0 parameter-generically, den(-w)-den(w)=2 sinh(2w/ell) sinh(L_s/ell)>0. Certified BEFORE division. Positive orientation SIGN is a labelled CONVENTION; positive MAGNITUDE is EARNED. Register edge R57.
Q_chi=I_s/N_chi=s (Q_+=+1,Q_-=-1): charge SIGN is the +/-w Z2 orientation. Proved from odd-kernel antisymmetry AND generic I_plus>0 certification.

Varying the reduced mouth functional gives h-Euler density eta_i*(k_m*h - g_chih*s_i); integrated amplitude k_m*h - g_chih*s, bare (h=0) component -g_chih*s != 0. From live functional-to-Euler wiring.
Exterior stationary field (3D radial Euler d/dr(r^2 dh/dr)=0, decaying, h(a)=h_A) is h(r)=h_A*a/r -- the h-mediated 1/R potential. h_A=P0*H|_A=xi_w|_A/ell, [h_A]=1.
Exterior holding energy with kappa_ext>0 a GENERIC positive exterior h-gradient stiffness -- NOT identified with kappa=D/B_eff. Holding curvature 4*pi*kappa_ext*a>0.
Positive holding curvature of E_ext in h_A (a>0, kappa_ext>0).

Named neutral fact NONZERO_HA_REQUIRES_CORE_HOLDER: the ONLY stationary point of the core-less exterior energy 2*pi*kappa_ext*a*(h_A-shift)^2 at shift=0 is h_A=0. A guaranteed-nonzero far-field amplitude requires the deferred core holder. Exported; consumed by stage032. Register edge R61.
Response Robin scale kappa=D/b (b=B_eff), escape-normalized in m=Z^T diag(b^-1,kappa^-1) Z. Distinct from kappa_ext. Consumes stage030 D. Register edge R58.
Completed-square response entry, m=Z^T diag(b^-1,kappa^-1) Z with Z=[[1,0],[-(C_hu/B_eff)*z_b, z_g]]. m_uu=1/b only when C_hu*z_b=0. Z_21=-(C_hu/B_eff)*z_b has [Z_21]=L. z_b carried opaque.
Off-diagonal completed-square response entry; m symmetric (m=m^T).
Pair-coupling response amplitude, [m_gg]=L/E. Register edge R59. Consumed by stage032 BC ensembles.
Response determinant, [det m]=M^-2 T^4. Register edge R59.
m_gg>=0 (and det m>=0) EARNED via z_g^2 given B_eff>0, D>0. Strict m_gg>0/det m>0 only at the POSTULATED z_g witness. All response amplitudes vanish at z_g=0.

Numeric witness at (B_eff,K_h,C_hu,z_b,z_g)=(2,1,1/2,1,1): D*=7/4 (consumed from stage030/kernel_stability), m*=(1/7)[[4,-2],[-2,8]], so m_gg*=B_eff/D=8/7, m_uu*=K_h/D=4/7, m_ug*=-C_hu/D=-2/7. Dimensionless witness kept DISTINCT from physical response dims.
Self-response S_gg=<eta,L_h^-1 eta> via explicit Galerkin quadratic form; positive for positive L_h (DERIVED). [S_gg]=E^-1. Enters stage032 Dirichlet coefficient.

Neutral far-field shell amplitude, [A]=E*L, with C an unspecified real class numerator [C]=E^2. Register edge R60. The class numerator C (which fixes force SIGN) is NOT specified, NO sign picked -- allowed/conditional leading form (U|_{C=0}=0 admissible). Nonzero amplitude requires the deferred core holder. Consumed by stage032.
Two-throat interaction potential; 1/R form and s_1*s_2 product (bilinear response + orientation-odd source) are target-blind EARNED. [U]=E.
Far-field force F=-dU/dR; 1/R^2 falloff and s_1*s_2 product are target-blind EARNED. [F]=E/L.
